provenance: Synthetic prompts for the search head (#713), 2026-10-26: does answering this turn well need the live web? Each item's `search` is a CANDIDATE label. Two pools. Seeded: tools/router/data/tool_router_train.json, its web group true and every other group false (463 items). Generated: 398 prompts from gemini-3.5-flash-lite through the offload CLI, asked per category for news, weather, sports, prices, releases, local now, explicit search asks and changing facts (true) and history, science, how-to, creative, code, opinion and chat, lookalikes that use now-words for stable knowledge, and culture and geography (false); it was told never to use the pattern 'tell me the history of <a city>', so the #680 lines are scored on phrasing the head never saw. Held out before anything was relabelled, and refused by train_search_head.py: every ChatEvalFixtures prompt (the test set, the vision fixtures included), the voice-rig lines (tools/eval/voice_rig_turns.txt and voice_rig_history.txt), the two #680 lines, and lexical near-copies of any of them (token Jaccard 0.5 or more after folding case and punctuation, at any length; a paraphrase in other words is not caught). The pool's first pass ran at a looser bar (0.75, or 0.5 for lines of four words or fewer) and dropped 3 seeded items (one an exact voice-rig line the gate's own data carries) and 3 generated ones (two of them fixture prompts the generator wrote word for word); the 0.5 bar (the 2026-10-26 review) dropped 4 more of each after the relabel. Every pooled candidate (855: 460 seeded, 395 generated) was relabelled cold by claude-haiku-5.5 through the same CLI (temperature 0, one boolean per prompt, batches of 40), and only agreements are kept: 20 disagreed (10 seeded, 10 generated). Kept: 446 seeded and 381 generated, 827 items, 220 of them must-search. What left the machine: the category descriptions (to the generator) and the 855 synthetic candidate prompts (to the relabeller; the seeded ones are already public in this repo). No fixture, rig, #680 or user line was sent to either model; the 8 lines the 0.5 bar caught after the relabel are synthetic siblings of fixture lines, not the lines. The teacher pass ran on 2026-10-26 in #713's eval stage, and it is NOT the planned decision model: Clef-flash-4bit (mlx-community/clef-flash-4bit at b5adbe2c, 6.2 GB) was downloaded under ~/scratch, but the session's permission check refused to run its bundled loader (code from outside the repo), so the plan's fallback labeller ran instead and the download was deleted. Teacher: gemini-4-argon through the same offload CLI (Google AI Studio; another model and generation than the 3.5 flash-lite generator, another family than the haiku relabeller), temperature 0, batches of 40, one question per prompt: does answering this message well need a live web search? (yes for current, recent or changing information, or an ask to search, look up online or open a page; no for stable knowledge, reasoning, writing, the conversation, or the user's own device, notes, files and calendar), answered as a stated probability from 0 to 1 and recorded as `teacher: {model, p}`. A stated probability is a model's verbalised confidence, not a decision head's calibrated p. It agreed with 819 of 827 candidates at the bars (217 must-search, 602 local); 2 disagreed (p 0.92 and 0.96 on local candidates) and 6 sat between the bars. Hand check (claude-opus-5.5 reading each, not Kev): 60 items, stratified as all 8 unconfirmed, the 14 confirmed nearest a bar, and a seeded draw per category with history, culture, lookalikes and changing facts weighted up. 52 agreed with candidate and teacher; 1 is overridden ('What's your opinion on the latest Marvel movie?' is must-search: which film is the latest is a web fact); 7 read ambiguous and carry no `hand`, so they stay unconfirmed and untrained (two URL finds, 'Latest model?', the new Berlin flats, and three moon or space-race lookalikes). `hand` is recorded on the 53 that were clear. What left the machine for the teacher: the 827 synthetic prompts again, to Google; no fixture, rig, #680 or user line. A candidate is confirmed when the teacher agrees at p 0.8 or more (0.2 or less for local), and the trainer ships only confirmed labels; `hand` (a stratified hand check) overrides both. The generation script was a one-off and is not committed; this paragraph is its method.
